_note: Organizations are REAL and their work is described accurately, but the mission text is a factual summary written for this project, not a verbatim quote of any org's official mission statement. `annual_budget` is an approximate order-of-magnitude figure used only for budget-fit filtering, not a reported financial. `ein` values ARE real, resolved via the ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer API and matched on name + city; tax-exempt verification detail for each lives in fixtures/irs_verification.json. Exactly one entry in this file is SYNTHETIC and is flagged with "synthetic": true - it is the only org carrying a 'revoked' status, and it exists solely to exercise the verification-gate code path in the demo. No real organization here is or ever will be labeled revoked. See README.

nonprofits.name: Rainforest Trust
nonprofits.mission: Purchases and permanently protects threatened tropical forest habitat by funding local conservation partners in the countries where the land sits, rather than operating reserves directly.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Acres of threatened habitat placed under permanent legal protection per dollar granted

nonprofits.name: Clean Air Task Force
nonprofits.mission: Pushes for the technology and policy changes needed to decarbonize energy systems, focusing on neglected high-leverage options like superhot rock geothermal, advanced nuclear, and methane regulation.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Tons of CO2-equivalent abated through enacted policy and regulatory change

nonprofits.name: Carbon180
nonprofits.mission: A policy-focused NGO working to build a carbon removal industry in the United States, advising lawmakers on procurement, soil carbon, and direct air capture programs.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Federal carbon removal appropriations influenced per program dollar

nonprofits.name: Tradewater
nonprofits.mission: Locates, collects, and permanently destroys abandoned stockpiles of refrigerants and other potent greenhouse gases that would otherwise leak into the atmosphere.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Tons of CO2-equivalent destroyed and independently verified
nonprofits.ein_unresolved_reason: No 501(c)(3) record found in the IRS Business Master File. Tradewater operates as a for-profit public benefit corporation, not a tax-exempt charity, so a gift to it would not be tax-deductible. Left unverified rather than matched to a similarly-named unrelated org.

nonprofits.name: Climate Emergency Fund
nonprofits.mission: Funds disruptive climate protest and advocacy movements, backing organizers and civil resistance campaigns that conventional environmental funders will not support.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Activist campaigns seeded and sustained per grant cycle

nonprofits.name: DonorsChoose
nonprofits.mission: Lets public school teachers post specific classroom project needs and have them crowdfunded directly, with materials shipped to the school rather than cash sent to the teacher.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Students reached per fully funded classroom project

nonprofits.name: Khan Academy
nonprofits.mission: Provides free online lessons, practice exercises, and mastery tracking across math, science, and the humanities, available to anyone with an internet connection.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Learners completing mastery-level practice per year

nonprofits.name: Reading Partners
nonprofits.mission: Trains community volunteers to deliver structured one-on-one literacy tutoring inside under-resourced elementary schools, targeting students reading below grade level.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Students achieving grade-level reading growth per tutoring cycle

nonprofits.name: 826 Valencia
nonprofits.mission: Runs writing and tutoring centers for under-resourced Bay Area students aged six to eighteen, pairing classroom support with student publishing programs.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Students receiving sustained one-on-one writing support per school year

nonprofits.name: Habitat for Humanity
nonprofits.mission: Builds and repairs affordable homes in partnership with the families who will live in them, who contribute labor hours and buy the home on affordable terms.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Families housed per construction dollar deployed

nonprofits.name: Community Housing Partnership
nonprofits.mission: Develops and operates permanent supportive housing in San Francisco for people leaving homelessness, pairing tenancy with on-site services and resident employment programs.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Formerly homeless tenants retaining housing at twelve months

nonprofits.name: Miracle Messages
nonprofits.mission: Reunites people experiencing homelessness with estranged family and friends through volunteer-assisted outreach, and runs a direct cash transfer program for unhoused individuals.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Family reunifications completed and cash transfers delivered per year

nonprofits.name: Destination: Home
nonprofits.mission: A collective-impact organization in Santa Clara County combining homelessness prevention cash assistance, supportive housing finance, and county-wide data coordination.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Households prevented from entering homelessness per prevention dollar

nonprofits.name: Partners In Health
nonprofits.mission: Builds long-term public health system capacity in under-resourced countries by staffing and supplying public hospitals and clinics alongside government health ministries.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Patient visits delivered through strengthened public facilities

nonprofits.name: Against Malaria Foundation
nonprofits.mission: Funds, distributes, and independently verifies the use of long-lasting insecticide-treated bed nets in malaria-endemic regions, publishing distribution data down to the household level.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Deaths averted per net distributed and verified in use

nonprofits.name: Evidence Action
nonprofits.mission: Scales public health interventions with strong randomized-trial evidence behind them, principally school-based deworming and chlorine dispensers for safe drinking water.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Cost per disability-adjusted life year averted

nonprofits.name: Muso Health
nonprofits.mission: Deploys proactive community health workers who search door to door for patients in Mali and Cote d'Ivoire, aiming to shorten the delay between symptom onset and treatment.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Reduction in time from symptom onset to care per patient served

nonprofits.name: HealthRIGHT 360
nonprofits.mission: Provides integrated primary care, mental health, and substance use treatment to Californians regardless of ability to pay, with a focus on people leaving incarceration or homelessness.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Clients retained in integrated treatment at six months

nonprofits.name: SF-Marin Food Bank
nonprofits.mission: Distributes free groceries across San Francisco and Marin counties through neighborhood pantries and home delivery, emphasizing fresh produce over shelf-stable packaged food.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Meals distributed per dollar, weighted toward fresh produce

nonprofits.name: The Farmlink Project
nonprofits.mission: Moves surplus produce that would be left unharvested or landfilled from farms to food banks, covering the transport and labor costs that block the donation.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Pounds of surplus produce rescued per logistics dollar

nonprofits.name: Replate
nonprofits.mission: Recovers surplus prepared food from Bay Area companies and caterers and delivers it same-day to community organizations, tracking both meals delivered and emissions avoided.
nonprofits.impact_metric: Meals rescued and methane emissions avoided per pickup route
